[[File:Tambor_Covetous.png|thumb|right|180px|Wat Tambor in a pressure suit]]
The '''Skakoan pressure suit''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] suit designed and worn by the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoans]] of [[Skako/Legends|Skako]].

==Characteristics==
Because the Skakoans had evolved in the high-pressure [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] on Skako, they were unable to live on [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] without a similar heavy atmosphere or mix of unique air chemicals. Hence, Skakoan scientists created the pressure suit, enabling the natives to travel offworld. This was particularly useful for members of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]; Foreman [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] always wore his pressure suit (which he had designed himself) while visiting Union foundry worlds or on business for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

[[File:Teska.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Kul Teska]]'s enhanced cyborg pressure suit]]
Skakoan pressure suits were equipped with synthesized vocalizers that distorted the wearer's speech patterns, making them sound more like a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] than a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] being. This, coupled with the fact that few non-Skakoans ever saw a member of the [[Species/Legends|species]] without a pressure suit, gave the Skakoans an air of mystery. Many in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] saw the Skakoans as heartless automatons, little different from the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] they constructed.

Although highly useful for the [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-faring members of the species, Skakoan pressure suits had their downsides. For one, they were very expensive, so only a limited number of Skakoans ever left their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Most distressing, however, was the effect of a breach or failure in the pressure suit while on a low-atmosphere world. If the Skakoan was ever exposed to low-pressure environments, they would explosively decompress. This horrific trait was occasionally used as a weapon; the mercenary [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] caused a huge explosion in a factory on [[Queyta]] by firing upon pressure-suited Skakoan workers, and a pair of [[Skakoan legal deputies|Skakoan mercenaries]] breached their own pressure suits to cause an explosion during the rescue of Wat Tambor from a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]].

Also, toward the climax of the Clone Wars, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to kill Skakoans during the [[Battle of Nelvaan]], without making their bodies explode. He used a similar technique when he pierced the suit of Wat Tambor during Skywalker's [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|execution]] of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].
